newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brittan praises Polish economic efforts.
newsitem.headline: Brittan praises Polish economic efforts.

text.p: European Union Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan on Thursday praised Poland's efforts to reform its economy, but warned against protectionism as a short-term fiscal fix.
A European Commission spokesman said Brittan made his comments during a meeting with Polish Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati during which they discussed trade ties.
Earlier this year the Commission -- the EU's executive -- criticised Poland for extending a period of protection on some domestic industries, particularly oil and steel.
Brittan warned against this as an economic fix, the spokesman said.

EU sources have said in the past that extending trade barriers could harm Poland's bid for EU membership. Poland is a frontrunner for EU enlargement and negotiations on joining are due to begin next year.
The commission spokesman said Brittan and Rosati had a productive exchange of views. "They were of a similar mind on the issue of barriers and protectionism," he said.
